title: Modular card grid that reflows in a loop
summary: Dark rounded cards in a fixed panel re-tile three times: columns slide, then rows, then columns, each move landing on a new layout and the last back on the first. Short holds let each set read.
use_when: Showing 6 to 8 pieces of work, features or screens at once without cuts
A looping hero or background clip for a site, a deck or a feed
A studio or product overview where the layout itself is the motion
Silent autoplay where no copy has to carry the message

look.type_style: small regular grotesk labels, sentence case, about 1 % of frame height, top-left of each card; tiny mono footer labels

structure.shot: layout A: light panel with 6 dark cards, two big left, a tall narrow, two small, a wide; footer wordmark and 3 tiny labels
the card columns slide vertically at different offsets inside the panel mask and land on layout B (5 cards, 2 columns)
structure.motion: column translateY, columns offset ~5 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutSine 60 fr (±0.25 s), overshoot not measurable; cards resize to the new tiling as they pass

structure.shot: layout B holds: left column one big and two short cards, right column two tall cards
the card rows slide sideways in opposite directions, new cards enter from the panel edges, landing on layout C (8 cards)
structure.motion: row translateX, top and bottom rows opposite, easings.inOutSine 60 fr (±0.25 s), overshoot not measurable

structure.shot: layout C holds: left two short cards over a big one, right a big card and a 2x2 block of small cards
columns slide vertically again and re-tile back toward layout A
structure.motion: column translateY, columns offset ~5 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutSine 53-60 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: layout A settles, identical to the first frame: the clip loops
structure.motion: last 8 fr (±0.25 s) of the settle, then hold to the loop point

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the panel, surface/fg for the cards, muted for labels, mono for the footer
params.content.items: 6-8 cards: image or clip plus a short label each
params.content.footer: wordmark plus up to 3 tiny labels along the bottom edge
params.layouts: 3 tilings (A, B, C) as column/row rects; the film runs A to B to C to A
params.timing.columnOffset: frames between columns starting to move (default 5)

notes: Zero cuts; the panel frame, background gradient and footer never move, only the cards inside the mask do. Cycle hold 22 fr + move 60 fr = about 83 fr per layout, metronomic. First and last frame match, so loopable. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): column-scroll-reflow, row-slide-reflow. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Timings at 0.25 s resolution from sheets.
